findings.problem: Still not fixed. The subject still says "Last chance". That is fake urgency, which voice.md bans unless it is true. The exclamation mark also breaks the calm, no-shouting tone.
findings.fix: Use a calm subject with no deadline, for example: "Build your portfolio in 12 weeks". Only mention a deadline if there is a real enrolment date, and then give the date plainly.

findings.problem: Still not fixed. The opening line still says "This is your last chance to join". That is fake urgency and pressure.
findings.fix: Replace it with a calm opener that says what the bootcamp is, for example: "I wanted to tell you about our 12-week Data Science Bootcamp. It's fully online."

findings.problem: Partly fixed. The "100% job guarantee" claim and "ends soon" are gone, but the preview still ends with "Don't miss out." That is a pressure phrase, which goes against the calm, never-pushy voice.
findings.fix: Drop "Don't miss out." For example: "12 weeks, 4 real projects and a mentor who reviews your work."

findings.problem: Still not fixed. The body still has a second link ("Read the full syllabus" to /syllabus). emails.md rule 3 allows exactly one main link, and it must point to https://datapath.example/bootcamp.
findings.fix: Remove the syllabus link, or make it plain text with no link (for example, "You'll find the full syllabus on the bootcamp page."). Keep only the [Enrol now] link.

findings.problem: Still not fixed. The file name "01-bad.md" does not start with an email ID from a campaign plan, as emails.md rule 5 requires (for example "E1-...").
findings.fix: Rename it to match its plan ID, for example "E1-bad.md". If this test campaign has no plan, give it an ID that follows the same pattern.
